item.title: Men are charged with trespass at Prince and Princess of Wales's home
item.body: Men have been charged with trespass at the home of the Prince and Princess of Wales. The charges follow a call to police about reports of suspicious activity on the Sandringham estate.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 👑 Men are charged with trespass at Prince and Princess of Wales's home

Men have been charged with trespass at the home of the Prince and Princess of Wales. The charges follow a call to police about reports of suspicious activity on the Sandringham estate.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 25 November, 10:20
